name: Bash Command Safety
directive: Block dangerous Bash commands: force-push to main/master, catastrophic deletes, sudo, .env writes, curl/wget piped to shell
message: Dangerous Bash command blocked. Prohibited: force-push to main/master, rm -rf / or ~, sudo, writing to .env, curl|bash / wget|sh (remote code exec). Defense-in-depth alongside settings.json deny rules.
